contributes.instructions: Pasting HTML on the canvas (Cmd+V with markup as plain text, or text/html that is more than a single paragraph of prose; a paragraph copied from a page lands as canvas text through the Text plugin instead) is a new page, and making a page on the canvas is not yet in the project model: the paste is claimed, nothing is placed, and the console says so in Daydream's words. A paste of more than 10,000 elements or four million characters is refused before that. HTML the user wants in the project becomes a page by being written as an html file of the project.
